title: Frontend upgrade: prefer backend-published posts with seed fallback, add owner ingestion UI, and render post images without changing routes/layout

requirements.summary: Preserve current URL/routing/layout and keep Google Search Console verification meta tags intact while adding new functionality additively.
acceptanceCriteria: The file frontend/index.html still contains the existing google-site-verification meta tag with the same content value.
No routes in frontend/src/App.tsx are removed or renamed.
Header/footer/layout components remain present and visually consistent (no intentional redesign).

file_operations.description: Add a nearby non-functional comment warning not to remove/alter existing meta tags; ensure the existing <meta name="google-site-verification" content="hym4U2k_e6Y32exhxiM5yIhLCPh_rYLDWpY5B2Mr9wQ" /> remains unchanged.
Add an unlinked owner-only ingestion route (e.g., /owner/ingest) without removing/renaming any existing routes; keep existing route tree intact.
If needed for the new unlinked owner route, ensure layout remains visually consistent (no redesign); avoid altering header/footer structure.

requirements.summary: Add a minimal, non-disruptive owner ingestion UI (unlinked route) with guarded access and success/failure status feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides an authenticated/guarded ingestion method that accepts: raw text and/or a source URL, optional hints (desired category/state tags), and stores the submission in a queue.
Frontend provides a minimal submission UI that is not disruptive to the public site experience (e.g., an unlinked route or a simple form page), and submitting shows a success/failure banner.
The ingestion flow does not require changing existing public navigation or layout.

file_operations.description: Create a minimal owner ingestion form page (unlinked) that collects raw content and/or source URL plus optional hints (category/state tags), calls the backend ingestion capability via the actor, and displays success/failure using the existing FormStatusBanner component. Use the selected authorization component patterns to require login and admin role checks; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small hook to (a) detect authentication via the existing Internet Identity context, (b) query the backend for admin status (e.g., isCallerAdmin/getCallerUserRole) using React Query, and (c) expose loading/authorized states for guarding the owner ingestion page. Use the selected authorization component patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a simple access denied screen used by the owner ingestion route when the caller is not authorized (guest/non-admin), without impacting public pages. Use the selected authorization component guidance for unauthorized UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire OwnerIngestPage into the router as an unlinked route (e.g., /owner/ingest). Do not add it to header/mobile navigation to keep the public UX unchanged.
If required to support the ingestion page UX, extend banner usage ergonomics (e.g., allow a compact variant or improved error text handling) without changing existing behavior across the public site.

requirements.summary: Render a per-post image when available from backend-published posts and show a safe fallback when missing or image generation fails.
acceptanceCriteria: When a post is published, it has an associated image reference (id/URL/path) that the frontend can render.
Images are produced programmatically within the app stack (no external LLM/image-generation API integration required).
If image generation fails, the post still publishes and the frontend shows a safe fallback image state.

file_operations.description: Extend UpdateItem with an optional imageUrl field so cards and detail pages can render backend-provided images while remaining compatible with existing seedUpdates.

Add optional image rendering to UpdateCard when update.imageUrl is present; if absent/invalid, render a safe fallback image state using the static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/site-logo.dim_512x128.png (do not break existing card layout).

Render a hero/cover image for the post when available (backend imageUrl), otherwise use a safe fallback image state referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png or frontend/public/assets/generated/site-logo.dim_512x128.png; keep the existing content layout and route behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Ensure public pages remain populated via frontend fallback behavior when backend has no queued/published content (supports hands-free daily publishing without empty states).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend runs a scheduled job daily that publishes at least one queued processed item when available.
If no queued items exist, the site still displays content on each category page (frontend falls back to existing seed content rather than showing empty states).
Publishing does not require manual triggers, logins, or dashboard actions beyond occasional ingestion submissions.

file_operations.description: Prefer backend-published posts for the home 'latest' sections; when backend returns none, fall back to seedUpdates so the home experience is never empty and layout remains unchanged.
Replace the current empty-state message with seed fallback behavior when backend has no items for the category; keep existing page design and route unchanged.
Prefer backend results; if backend yields zero posts, fall back to seedUpdates instead of rendering a 'No results' empty state.
Prefer backend admit-card posts; if backend yields zero posts, fall back to seedUpdates instead of rendering an empty state.
Prefer backend scheme posts; if backend yields zero posts, fall back to seedUpdates instead of rendering an empty state.
Prefer backend scholarship posts; if backend yields zero posts for the active filter, fall back to seedUpdates while keeping the existing filter UI and layout unchanged.
Prefer backend competitive-exam posts for the updates listing section; if backend yields zero posts, fall back to seedUpdates without changing the page’s informational sections.
Prefer backend school-education posts; if backend yields zero posts, fall back to seedUpdates instead of showing empty state.
When browsing state-specific listings, prefer backend posts (filtered client-side by stateTags when available) and fall back to seedUpdates to avoid empty state pages.

requirements.summary: Update frontend data sourcing so all listing/search/detail views prefer backend-published posts and fall back to seedUpdates without changing routes or overall layout.
acceptanceCriteria: HomePage and category pages show backend posts when available.
When backend returns zero posts for a category, the page renders seedUpdates content instead of 'No updates available' empty states.
Post detail route (/post/$postId) can resolve both backend post ids and seedUpdates ids without breaking navigation.

file_operations.description: Add adapter utilities to map backend Post (union) into the existing UpdateItem shape, including category mapping to existing UpdateCategory values, date formatting from lastUpdatedAt, excerpt/body/title, stateTags, and imageUrl.

Create React Query hooks that fetch published posts by category (and optionally fetch by id) using the existing actor, returning UpdateItem[] via backendPostAdapters. Keep public browsing available without requiring login.
Create a helper/hook that merges backend-derived updates with seedUpdates, preferring backend items, and provides convenience selectors for per-category lists and latest items used by pages.
Switch home 'latest' sections to use useCombinedUpdates (backend-first, seed fallback) while preserving the existing hero/design and section structure.
Use combined backend-first updates for the Education News listing; ensure seed fallback replaces the current empty state when backend has no items.
Use combined backend-first updates for School Education listings; preserve layout, copy, and SEO behavior.
Use combined backend-first updates for the competitive exam updates listing area while preserving the existing informational sections and layout.
Use combined backend-first updates for scholarships, keeping the existing filter tabs; when filtering by state, filter combined items by stateTags when present (fallback remains seedUpdates).
Use combined backend-first updates for schemes; preserve existing layout and SEO behavior.
Use combined backend-first updates for results; remove reliance on empty state when seed fallback should display content.
Use combined backend-first updates for admit cards; preserve existing layout and SEO behavior.
Update search to query across combined backend-first updates rather than seedUpdates only; keep URL param behavior and page layout unchanged.
If needed, adjust search utilities to handle optional fields (e.g., stateTags/imageUrl) and ensure sorting works for combined updates without changing current behavior for seed-only.
Update post detail to first attempt loading a backend post by id (via hook), and if not found fall back to seedUpdates getUpdateById; preserve route /post/$postId and existing detail layout.
